anchor.section: What do moisturisers contain? — Emollients and Occlusives

evidence.note: DermNet describes emollients as containing oily substances that soften and smooth skin, and occlusive agents as a lipophilic oil layer on skin that reduces evaporative water loss. This supports a conditional physical relation only if an oily or fatty application actually remains as a continuous hydrophobic surface film; it does not establish that every ordinary fat or oil has suitable composition, stays in place, is tolerated, heals skin, treats disease, or suits burns, weeping, or infected skin.

claim_localizations.runtime_text: Если маслянистое или жирное нанесение на кожу действительно остаётся сплошной гидрофобной поверхностной плёнкой, оно может уменьшить испарительную потерю влаги с поверхности кожи. Это условная физическая связь, а не обещание, что любой жир или масло годится, останется на месте, переносится кожей, лечит повреждение или подходит для ожога, мокнущей либо инфицированной кожи.

Where an oily or fatty skin application actually remains as a continuous hydrophobic surface film, it can reduce evaporative water loss from the skin surface. This is a conditional physical relation, not a promise that every fat or oil is suitable, stays in place, is tolerated, heals damage, or suits burns, weeping, or infected skin.
